item.description:
AgentsEye 0.17.23 brings quotas to the macOS desktop and adds an optional way to support the app.
- Add small and medium widgets for Codex or up to four enabled providers. They follow the dashboard's quota window, remaining/used mode, provider filter, sort order, and appearance. - Keep widget sharing local and minimal. The extension receives quota percentages, reset times, pace, and availability, without prompts, sessions, credentials, account IDs, or network access. - Add **Copy quota summary** for a private Markdown snapshot that is easy to paste into planning notes or a conversation. - Add an optional Founding Supporter subscription at USD 6/month or USD 48/year. Every beta feature remains free; Stripe handles payment details in the browser. - Make supporter checkout, restore, cancellation, refunds, disputes, retries, and duplicate webhooks fail safely without creating a second subscription or exposing Stripe customer data to the app. - Replace in-place local installs with a staged, verified app replacement so removed widget or framework files cannot survive an update.

Fix rapid-usage alerts that missed gradual quota drain. AgentsEye now tracks cumulative usage across refreshes within the last hour, so a drop from 100% to 83% remaining triggers the enabled 10-point alert. Readings from earlier quota cycles and readings older than an hour are excluded.

AgentsEye 0.17.21 stops repeated Claude Code Keychain prompts.
- Background refresh no longer reads Claude Code's Keychain item. - Background refresh no longer launches `claude auth status`, which could independently request Keychain access every five minutes. - Disconnecting Claude usage now prevents all Claude credential reads while keeping local Claude session history available. - Connected Claude usage can still use an existing on-device credentials file or a current claude.ai session in Zen or Firefox. - OpenCode Go continues to use the correct 5-hour, weekly, and monthly windows. Its API currently reports whole-number percentages, while the OpenCode dashboard may show decimals.
